source_row.acip: SOS KA'I DUS SU ZLA BA'I REG BYA'I CHA SHAS GCIG GIS NYER LEN DANG , YI DVAGS KYI LAS KYIS LHAN CIG BYED RKYEN BYAS PA LA BRTEN NAS, DE'I LUS SHES KYI MYONG BYAR GYUR PA'I TSA BA'I REG BYA SKYE BA DANG , DGUN DUS SU NYI MA'I REG BYA'I CHA SHAS GCIG GIS NYER LEN DANG , YI DVAGS KYI LAS KYIS LHAN CIG BYED RKYEN BYAS PA LA BRTEN NAS, DE'I LUS SHES KYI MYONG BYAR GYUR PA'I GRANG BA'I REG BYA SKYE BA YOD PA LTA BU YIN PA'I PHYIR,
source_row.wylie: sos ka'i dus su zla ba'i reg bya'i cha shas gcig gis nyer len dang , yi dvags kyi las kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa la brten nas, de'i lus shes kyi myong byar gyur pa'i tsha ba'i reg bya skye ba dang , dgun dus su nyi ma'i reg bya'i cha shas gcig gis nyer len dang , yi dvags kyi las kyis lhan cig byed rkyen byas pa la brten nas, de'i lus shes kyi myong byar gyur pa'i grang ba'i reg bya skye ba yod pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir
source_row.english: Another example would be the moon in springtime; one part of the feel of its rays on the body provides the material cause, and then the karma of a craving spirit provides a contributing factor. Based on these two, the spirit gets a sensation of heat, which is experienced by the consciousness of the body. So too with the wintertime sun; one part of the feel of its rays on the body provides the material cause, and then the karma of the craving spirit provides a contributing factor. Based on these two, the spirit gets a sensation of cold, which is experienced by the consciousness of the body.
